background.value: plain (colored photo with plain background, no distracting shadows or images)

face_visibility.value: full face (front view) from top of hair to bottom of chin, eyes open

headwear_policy.value: head coverings not permitted except for religious reasons; facial features from chin to forehead must be visible

size.evidence: The official Tanzania immigration website (visa.immigration.go.tz/guidelines) specifies the photo dimension as '45mm (length) X 35 mm (Width)' and states the photo size should not exceed these dimensions. The '(maximum)' qualifier in the claim accurately reflects the official guideline language. Multiple third-party sources (atlys.com, 2x2passportphoto.com) corroborate 35x45mm. Note: some third-party sites (visafoto, mybiometricphotos) cite 40x45mm, but the official government source is authoritative and confirms the claimed 45x35mm.
